unnamed_1: Season 35 is the most recent season of TAR, despite the fact that Season 36 exists. Season 36 was filmed before Season 35, but released after because of the change to hour-and-a-half long episodes. Season 35 has been branded as a return to form for TAR, as global COVID restrictions have been loosened, allowing for traditional travel between legs, which is a significant part of the race in seasons past. This sheet is dedicated to documenting Season 35, so some predictions could be made about Season 37.
- Season 35 started with 13 teams, a historic high.
- Season 35 is the first COVID season with 12 legs.
- This season continued the trend of no non-elimination legs from the previous two seasons, but had one non-elim leg because teams were instructed to continue racing.
- The Scramble was utilized for the second time on the final leg of this season.
- There were two Express Passes given out, and they were earned in separate, voluntary challenges. This is different than the traditional way to earn the pass, by coming in first on a specific leg.
